Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

God forbid! interjection

also heaven forbid, perish the thought, don’t say that!, touch wood, heaven help us

classical

Cic. Sen. 47: ‘dī meliōra!’ inquit
Plaut. Poen. 1400: Dī meliōra faxint.

Dī meliōra!

heaven forbid! (lit. the gods [grant] better things)

The verb (dent, faciant) is left out.

Other words

  • Dī melius faciant! — heaven forbid!

    subjunctive of wish; also faxint, duint · also used · classical · Plaut. Ps. 315; Plaut. Merc. 285: Dī melius faxint.; Ter. Ph. 1005: dī melius duint; Traupman 327

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

  • Bona verba (quaesō)! — don’t say that! hush, words of good omen!

    also used · classical · Ter. And. 204: Bona verba, quaesō.; M-O s.v. hush, don’t say such a thing

    (vōx cōmica: Ter.)

    Said to stop an ill-omened remark.

Examples

  • ‘dī meliōra!’ inquit

    “God forbid!” he saidCic. Sen. 47

  • Dī meliōra faxint.

    Heaven forbid.Plaut. Poen. 1400

  • Mī homō, dī melius duint.

    My dear man, heaven forbid.Ter. Ph. 1005

  • Bona verba, quaesō.

    Don’t say that, please.Ter. And. 204

See also thank God!, good luck!, no way!.
